note: Hand-labelled from the U1 contract and U1RT-03: a certificate is read by its arity in either length form, nesting has no limit short of the transaction size, deep auxiliary and Plutus data are mentions, and a break a repeated key would hide leaves the transaction open. Independent of the Python reference (r57_first_use.py) and the Sextant predicate. Only target_found, complete and verdict are contract.
